description: Inspects PE/EXE/DLL (incl. .NET assemblies: runtime, types and methods), ELF, Mach-O (incl. universal), WebAssembly, Java .class, Android .dex, Lua/LuaJIT and Python bytecode: architecture, sections with entropy, imports/exports, PDB path, signing, overlay data (e.g. an embedded game pack), toolchain/engine hints and strings. Read-only: it does not unpack, decrypt or patch.

limit.description: Import and export names to return each (default 100).

match.description: Filter import/export names: substring, glob or /regex/i.

strings.description: String options: min, limit, match, maxMB, raw.

maxMB.description: Scan this many MiB for strings (default 64).

raw.description: Include strings that look like byte noise (default false).

name: re_binary
title: Inspect an executable or bytecode
